goal.en: Choose a movie with your friends and buy the tickets.
goal.zh: 跟朋友一起選電影，然後買票。

background: movie theater lobby at night with a red carpet, a popcorn stand, a ticket counter with blank screens, warm golden lights, velvet rope barriers, empty and quiet

intro.en: Friday night at Maple Bay Cinema. You, Mia, and Leo stand in front of the ticket counter.
intro.zh: 星期五晚上，楓灣電影院。你、米亞和里歐站在售票櫃檯前。

intro.en: Three movies are playing tonight: Star Racer, The Dark Lake, and Lucky Dog.
intro.zh: 今晚有三部電影：《星際飆客》、《暗湖》和《幸運狗》。

lines.en: So, what are you in the mood for, Kai?

choices.tip: What are you in the mood for? 是問你想看什麼類型，給個方向就好。

choices.en: I'm in a good mood today, thanks!

lines.en: Ha, that's great! But I meant, which movie?
lines.zh: 哈，那很好啊！但我是問你想看哪部？

story.en: Everyone is in a good mood, but nobody picks a movie. You end up watching the trailers in the lobby.
story.zh: 大家心情都很好，但沒人選電影，最後你們在大廳看了一晚的預告片。

fail.why: What are you in the mood for? 是問「你想要看什麼、吃什麼」，不是問你心情如何。回答想要的類型：Something fun.。

choices.en: Casual. Any movie is OK for me.

story.en: Mia checks your outfit and says you look casual enough. Nobody knows which movie to see.
story.zh: 米亞看了看你的穿著，說你夠休閒了。但還是沒人知道要看哪部。

fail.why: 「隨便」不能翻成 casual，casual 是「休閒的、不正式的」，用來形容穿著或場合。要說 I'm easy. 或 Anything is fine.，最好再給個方向。

lines.en: Comedy? Come on, let's see The Dark Lake! It's super scary!
lines.zh: 喜劇？拜託，我們看《暗湖》啦！超恐怖的！

choices.en: Hmm, I'm not a big fan of horror.
choices.tip: I'm not a big fan of... 是委婉說「不太喜歡」的好用句型。

choices.en: No way. Horror movies are so stupid.

lines.en: Stupid? Hey, horror is my favorite!
lines.zh: 蠢？喂，恐怖片是我的最愛耶！

story.en: Leo spends the whole bus ride explaining why horror movies are art.
story.zh: 里歐整趟公車都在解釋為什麼恐怖片是一種藝術。

fail.why: 不想看可以說自己的喜好，但說 stupid 等於批評喜歡它的人。說 I'm not a big fan of horror. 比較溫和。

lines.en: You're afraid... horror movies? Afraid OF them?
lines.zh: 你怕……恐怖片？是怕「它們」嗎？

story.en: Leo is so busy fixing your grammar that he forgets to argue. Lucky you.
story.zh: 里歐忙著幫你改文法，忘了跟你爭。算你運氣好。

fail.why: 「怕某樣東西」要說 be afraid of something，少了 of 句子就不完整：I'm afraid of horror movies.。

lines.en: Lucky Dog it is! Kai, can you get the tickets?
lines.zh: 那就看《幸運狗》吧！凱，你可以去買票嗎？

lines.en: I already bought mine online. I'll grab the popcorn!
lines.zh: 我已經在網路上買好我的票了，我去買爆米花！

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get for you?

choices.en: Two tickets for Lucky Dog at 7:30, please.
choices.zh: 兩張七點半的《幸運狗》，謝謝。
choices.tip: 買票句型：數量 + tickets for + 片名 + 時間 + please。

choices.en: Give me two Lucky Dog. The 7:30 one.
choices.zh: 給我兩張《幸運狗》，七點半那場。

lines.en: Two lucky dogs? Sorry, we only sell hot dogs.
lines.zh: 兩隻幸運狗？抱歉，我們只有賣熱狗。

story.en: Danny hands you two hot dogs. They're good, but they're not movie tickets.
story.zh: 丹尼遞給你兩份熱狗。很好吃，但不是電影票。

fail.why: 「給我兩張……」直翻成 Give me two... 太直接，又少了 tickets，對方聽不懂你要買什麼。說 Two tickets for..., please. 清楚又有禮貌。

choices.en: Two for Lucky Dog. Cheaper for two, right?
choices.zh: 兩張《幸運狗》。兩張比較便宜吧？

lines.en: Uh, no. It's the same price for everyone.
lines.zh: 呃，沒有喔。每個人都是一樣的價錢。

story.en: Danny calls his manager to ask about a "two-person deal." The line behind you gets very long.
story.zh: 丹尼打電話問經理有沒有「兩人優惠」，你後面的隊伍越排越長。

fail.why: 電影院、超市這類明碼標價的地方不能殺價。想省錢可以問有沒有學生票：Do you have student discounts?

lines.en: Sure thing! Would you like the middle or the back row?
lines.zh: 沒問題！要中間還是後排的座位？

choices.en: The middle, please. Two seats together.
choices.zh: 中間，謝謝。兩個連在一起的位子。
choices.tip: 二選一的問題直接說出選擇，再補上 two seats together 就很清楚。

choices.en: Middle. We would like sit together.

lines.en: Like sit? Oh, you'd like TO sit together?
lines.zh: 喜歡坐？喔，你是說想要坐一起？

story.en: Danny gets it in the end, but he gives you the last two seats in the front row. Your neck hurts all night.
story.zh: 丹尼最後懂了，但只剩第一排的兩個位子。你的脖子痛了一整晚。

fail.why: would like 後面要接 to + 原形動詞：We would like to sit together.。少了 to，聽起來像「我們喜歡坐」。

lines.en: Yes to which one? Middle or back?
lines.zh: 好是指哪一個？中間還是後排？

story.en: Danny gives you one seat in the middle and one in the back. Mia sits next to someone who eats popcorn very loudly.
story.zh: 丹尼給了你一個中間、一個後排的位子。米亞旁邊坐了一個吃爆米花超大聲的人。

fail.why: Middle or back? 是二選一的問題，不能用 Yes 回答。直接說出選擇：The middle, please.。

lines.en: Two in the middle for 7:30. Enjoy the movie!
lines.zh: 兩張中間的位子，七點半。祝你們觀影愉快！

lines.en: Look! I got the biggest popcorn they had!
lines.zh: 你們看！我買了最大桶的爆米花！

story.en: Everyone laughs through the whole movie, even Leo. On the way home, he admits Lucky Dog was better than The Dark Lake.
story.zh: 整部電影大家都笑個不停，連里歐也是。回家路上，他承認《幸運狗》比《暗湖》好看。

notes.en: What are you in the mood for?
notes.explain: be in the mood for something 是「想要某樣東西」，常用來問想看什麼電影、想吃什麼。回答 I'm in the mood for a comedy.。

example.en: I'm in the mood for pizza tonight.

notes.en: I'm not a big fan of...
notes.explain: 委婉表達不喜歡的好用句型，比 I don't like... 或 ...is stupid 溫和許多，不會讓喜歡的人不舒服。

example.en: I'm not a big fan of spicy food.

notes.explain: 買票的標準句型：數量 + tickets for + 片名或目的地 + 時間 + please，比 Give me... 有禮貌。

example.en: One ticket for the 9 o'clock show, please.
example.zh: 請給我一張九點那場的票。

notes.explain: 「隨便」不能翻成 casual，casual 是「休閒的」，形容穿著或場合。說 I'm easy. 或 Anything is fine. 才對，但最好再給個方向。

example.zh: 我都可以，也許看好笑的？

notes.explain: 在英語國家，電影院、超市、連鎖店都是明碼標價，問「便宜一點」會讓店員很為難。可以問有沒有學生優惠。
